nodes.label: Private Vulnerability Reporting
nodes.rationale: Sandbox and permission bugs should stay private until a fix ships so attackers do not receive advance notice.

nodes.label: Graph-First Navigation
nodes.rationale: Scoped graph queries are preferred because they return less context than the full report or raw search.

nodes.label: Standard-Library-Only Bridge
nodes.rationale: New runtime dependencies require a strong reason because the bridge deliberately uses only Python's standard library.

nodes.label: Graphify-First Codebase Navigation
nodes.rationale: When graph data exists, scoped query/path/explain operations precede broad source browsing, and code changes are followed by an incremental graph update.
